decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own page in both years, which signals an established, prominently marketed line that fits the firm's natural skincare core.
The hyaluronic serum is still listed after two years and suits the facial care range, though it is only mentioned rather than featured, which leaves some risk of a range cleanup.
The cleansing oil was launched recently in 2024 and may be replacing the dropped cleansing milk, so the firm will likely give it time on the market.
